objective.text: Plan a half-day workshop on March 12
objective.quote: I'm organizing a half-day workshop on data visualization for our regional library association. It's the morning of March 12. The venue holds 40 people and we've budgeted $600 total.

items.quote: Please draft the schedule: 9:00 arrival, two 75-minute sessions with a 20-minute break, 12:30 close.

items.text: Maker-space team only, for this workshop
items.quote: I think we should go with just the maker-space team for this workshop.
The maker-space team just confirmed for the 9:45 session.
The printer needs final details by March 20: session titles, speaker names, and the schedule.
Our budget review came back: the $600 total is firm, and no line item can exceed $300. Catering coverage up to $200.
